verification.summary: Source-pinned Mac ARM64 installer built and validated; DMG SHA-256 1d79b566be07230f88b6add30d3aefba24277cca82230acf62effc7f8efd34a8.

Packaged app performed a fenced task claim and reassignment, rejected a stale revision, saved a reviewer and one idempotent accepted message, recovered after UAR restart, and displayed the board in Teams settings. No unit or partial suites were run.

observedFailures: The first packaged launch found Axum rejecting a route segment that combined {task_id} and :claim. Changed task action routes to separate path segments and rebuilt only the failed app boundary.
optimization: Freeze source commits and payload revision before invoking the cadence checkpoint to avoid a second installer build after documentation-only commits.
Pass THE_BOSS_LOCAL_UAR_SOURCE_DIR into the cadence checkpoint environment; its first attempt failed immediately without that required variable.
Give each iteration a unique launch receipt path; the shared mac-functional-launch.json path was overwritten, requiring archival copies to preserve both results.
exactNextWork: Publish the second successful delivery to Mac ARM64/x64 and Windows x64/ARM64 with matching UAR source records, GitHub release metadata and current website links; then begin C09.3 aggregate admission.
